profile.name: Newport XPS多轴运动控制器
profile.description: Newport XPS是一类用于驱动和管理多轴电动位移台、直线台或旋转台的高精度运动控制器。它支持轴组初始化、回零、使能、位置运动、速度设置以及PVT轨迹扫描，常用于光学对准、精密定位、自动扫描和实验平台运动控制。
profile.description_en: The Newport XPS is a precision multi-axis motion controller used to drive and manage motorized translation and rotation stages. It supports group initialization, homing, enabling, point-to-point motion, velocity setup, and PVT trajectory scanning, and is commonly used for optical alignment, precision positioning, automated scanning, and laboratory motion control.
